# St. John's coastline fixture

`st_johns_osm_land.geojson` is a clipped derivative of OSM land polygons
downloaded for TritonEye. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0:
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/.
Source: https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/data/land-polygons.html.

Clip bounds (WGS84): [-52.725, 47.55, -52.668, 47.585]. The fixture retains
inland water as land for the marine detector. It is an offline regression input,
not an independently surveyed shoreline. Its artificial clipping edges must not
be used as shoreline outside the interior control locations.

Source shapefile SHA-256:
`aa13c07469a82836f9fafc7547e8aede7cb2b167b3826a094816fcea0b5bc996`.
